output.question: Has Humana announced layoffs?

passages.quote: Humana is eliminating some jobs as it introduces other roles, the company confirmed to Becker’s on Oct. 27.
to drive greater organizational efficiency, better meet the needs of our business and create greater value for our members and patients.
The company said it could not disclose the number of affected roles, the departments impacted or the timeline for cuts.

output.answer: Yes. Humana confirmed to Becker’s on October 27, 2026 that it was eliminating some jobs while introducing other roles. The company said the staffing adjustments were intended to improve organizational efficiency and meet business needs. It did not disclose the number of affected roles, impacted departments or timeline for the cuts.
caveats: The confirmation comes from Humana’s statement reported by Becker’s; the October 27 report leaves the scale and timing of the layoffs undisclosed.
missing_fields: Number of affected roles, impacted departments and layoff timeline—not disclosed in the report.

key_facts.fact: Humana confirmed that it was eliminating some jobs while introducing other roles.
Humana said its staffing adjustments aimed to improve organizational efficiency, meet business needs and create greater value for members and patients.
Humana declined to disclose the number of affected roles, impacted departments or timeline for the cuts.
